shots.note: medium push_in: Brahma sits on his lotus in a bright gold heaven below the title card; he opens his arms on 'creator' as rays of creation fall on him.
close pull_out: Close on Brahma's three faces: confidence drains, eyes drop and the brows knit on 'not' as the gold light cools.
wide pan_right: Brahma pleads toward his child-sage sons; on 'rejected' they turn their backs and walk away, and on 'wearing' he sags into grief in a cooling blue sky.
medium tilt_down: An iris opens on violet night at Kailash: Shiva meditates in silhouette and his blue halo brightens on 'god', the answer to the riddle.
two_shot crane_down: Stacked: Vishnu in his bright blue-gold heaven looks down with concern on 'noticed', Brahma below sits in grief with eyes lowered.
medium push_in: Vishnu speaks and on 'Mahadev' points toward the far snow peak of Kailash, which glows as 'Shiva' is said.
medium dolly_left: Brahma, standing, shakes his head in doubt; behind him a red storm glow rises on 'destroyer' to show what he thinks of Shiva.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Vishnu, open-handed and smiling, to Brahma, whose doubt softens into hope on 'counsel'.
wide dolly_right: On bright snowy Kailash Brahma walks in from the left toward Shiva, who sits still in meditation; Brahma stops in awe.
close push_in: Close on Brahma seated with folded hands; on 'prayed' he closes his eyes in devotion and a warm glow rises around him on 'soul'.
extreme_close static: Extreme close on Shiva's face: the closed eyes open on 'opened' and a pale blue halo ring pulses out behind his head.
medium pull_out: Shiva speaks with an open teaching hand on 'reproduction'; on 'sons' he looks down kindly, the faint child sages behind him recalling the failed way.
medium tilt_up: Adishakti appears in a rose-saffron sky on 'Shakti', arms opening, with golden rays and a halo behind her.
medium handheld: Shiva stands in a swirl of gold and blue light, eyes closing; on 'body' a seam of light runs down his middle and on 'changed' he dissolves into the half-Goddess form.
medium tilt_down: Ardhanarishvara stands full figure: blue light floods the male half on 'male', rose-gold the female half on 'female', and a seam of light runs down the centre on 'split'.
close push_in: Close on the half-Shiva, half-Goddess face inside a gold halo ring as the name is spoken; the name plate sits above the head.
wide pull_out: Ardhanarishvara stands between a blue half and a gold half of the cosmos; on 'halves' two glows meet at the seam, and on 'without' they pulse together.
two_shot crane_down: Stacked: the Goddess above, gentle and radiant; Brahma below bows on 'bowed' and joins his hands in namaste on 'asked'.
two_shot pan_left: The Goddess raises her hand on 'gave' and a stream of gold light flows from her to Brahma, who receives it with joy on 'force'.
medium push_in: Brahma glows with gold light from his own body; Manu takes shape beside him out of the light as 'Brahma made a man' is said, and joins his hands on 'Manu'.
two_shot dolly_right: Brahmi forms out of rose-gold light beside Manu on 'woman' and folds her hands on 'Brahmi'; Manu turns to her with joy.
wide crane_up: Manu and Brahmi walk together into a bright dawn valley with trees and a river, the world their children will fill.
medium push_in: Back on Kailash, Shiva sits calm with a gentle knowing smile; he did not create them, and he looks down kindly on 'humans'.
wide pull_out: Ardhanarishvara stands in gold light, blue and gold halves glowing; a halo ring opens on 'both halves', the answer made visible.
